description: Every public numeric or factual claim Lazaret makes, with an evidence pointer and a machine check. pnpm check:claims re-verifies each claim and fails on drift.

claims.statement: On the fixture micro-slice the compiled EXPOSES set equals the reference-model closure exactly: 3 members across depths 0, 1, and 2.
claims.limitations: Deterministic fixture, checked on every verify run against a live node.

claims.statement: The demonstration npm slice loaded into HydraDB contains 3980 packages, 31700 versions, and 85780 DEPENDS_ON edges.
claims.evidence: pnpm exec tsx apps/ingest/src/cli.ts crawl --max=3000 --depth=1 then load-dir; counts in data/slice/report.json and data/slice/load-report.json.
claims.limitations: A bounded slice seeded from npm-high-impact plus incident packages, not all of npm. Counts move with the crawl budget.

claims.statement: Compiling the September 2025 chalk/debug incident over the slice materialized a 983-version exposure closure across depths 0 to 5 from 16 real compromised targets, in 3.4 seconds over 110 reverse reads.
claims.evidence: pnpm exec tsx apps/ingest/src/cli.ts compile --incident=fixtures/incidents/chalk-debug-2025-09.json; record in data/compile-chalk-debug-2025-09.json.
claims.limitations: Closure size depends on the crawled slice. Malicious version numbers and timestamps were reconstructed from the live npm registry time map.

claims.statement: After compilation, blast radius at time t over the 983-member chalk/debug closure returns in about 56 ms warm for the full frame and 53 ms for a 513-row mid-incident frame.
claims.evidence: Direct HydraDB HTTP query MATCH (a:Advisory)-[e:EXPOSES]->(v) WHERE e.t_first <= $t, timed with curl.
claims.limitations: Local single-node measurement on Apple Silicon. Cold first call is about 246 ms.
